source.title: Residual-Stream Burden Shapes Representation Learning in Diffusion Transformers
source.authors: Tong-Tong Liang; Si-Qi Kou; Zi-Qiao Xi; Esha Singh; Kun Zhou; Zhi-Jie Deng; Alexander Cloninger; Yu-Xiang Wang; Rahul Parhi

record.file_problem: Full paper text supplied; no material truncation apparent.
record.tranche_reason: The study trains diffusion Transformers under varied prediction targets and residual-state designs, then measures generation quality and representation behavior. These are different measures and tasks from classification training error, but several results bear conceptually on whether training succeeds or fails under the named conditions.
record.gate_note: The paper does not measure training classification error or test fitting of classification labels. The relevant evidence is its reported diffusion training outcomes, including explicit failures and rescues under v-prediction; cited findings from other papers are not recorded as rows. FID and probe measurements are related training outcomes but do not establish classification training error.
record.test_reason: The study measures diffusion generation quality and hidden representations, not any version's specified optimization effect. Expanded residual bandwidth does not test spurious minima in two-layer teacher-student networks; identity carry does not test depth degradation; and the paper reports no initialization, batch-normalization, or stability-threshold comparison. Appendix A.4 discusses relevant prior findings without testing them.
record.authors_conclusion: The record's paraphrase is accurate. The authors argue that prediction targets determine what information must persist through depth, shaping learned representations. Their experiments connect patch spectral concentration and residual-state bandwidth to generation quality and class readability. They explicitly leave the training-time formation of these representations and its precise gradient dynamics unresolved.
record.recipe_differences: The study trains diffusion Transformers for image generation, evaluates FID and representation diagnostics, and varies prediction target, patch geometry, and residual-stream design. It does not use the classification-fitting recipes or classification-error measure named in the claim versions.
record.method_sensitivity: Outcomes vary with prediction target, pixel versus whitened patch space, plain versus expanded residual bandwidth, local state organization, class-token inclusion, and model scale. Probe readability also varies by representation space and input-noise level.

fits_no_version.finding: Plain pixel x-prediction reaches FID 10.19 versus 139.83 for v-prediction. Expanded residual state lowers v-prediction FID to 25.36; spatial organization and class tokens lower it further to 6.17. A learned input skip reaches 9.99 at 200 epochs and 6.70 at 400.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Prediction target and persistent-state organization affect generation quality in the tested pixel-space diffusion Transformers.

fits_no_version.finding: Invertible patch whitening raises x-prediction FID from 10.19 to 132.95; whitened v-prediction reaches 212.54.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Patch spectral concentration affects generation quality in the tested diffusion architecture.

fits_no_version.finding: Four-stream mHC improves DINO-space FID from 5.50 to 3.93 for x-prediction and from 16.56 to 3.98 for v-prediction.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Expanded persistent state especially benefits velocity prediction in the tested DINO latent diffusion models.

fits_no_version.finding: SiHC generation FID improves with model scale and continued training; XL with REPA reaches 1.71. The three decoupled B-size models also improve generation FID throughout training.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: The tested SiHC and decoupled diffusion architectures achieve improving generation quality under their respective scaling and training recipes.

fits_no_version.finding: Swiss-roll x-prediction concentrates hidden-state variance in few directions, whereas v-prediction requires over a hundred at the final observed block input.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Prediction target changes residual-state variance concentration in the tested toy flow-matching network.

fits_no_version.finding: At 50% noise, pixel x-prediction and SiHC have probe accuracies of 27.54% and 27.81%, versus 4.56% for pixel v-prediction. Both DINO models exceed 80%, and the noisy DINO input control already has high class readability.
fits_no_version.proposed_claim: Class readability depends on prediction space, target and residual-state organization; DINO models inherit substantial class information from their inputs.

record.problems: The paper explicitly says it does not trace how representation shaping unfolds during training and leaves open how much bandwidth representation learning requires. The study does not measure classification training error, so its FID and linear-probe outcomes cannot resolve the claim's classification-fitting versions. Most reported FID comparisons do not provide uncertainty intervals in the supplied text.
record.rows_left_out: No relevant reported results were left out under the claim versions. Referenced prior-work findings are cited background, not this study's own outcomes. Figure-only probe trajectories and sensitivity curves were not transcribed as numeric rows where the paper supplies no precise tabulated values; tabulated final-boundary probe values and explicit text results are included.

untested.parts: CIFAR-10/100 training classification error, fitting random or corrupted labels, and dependence on model size, early stopping or regularization.
Spurious-minimum frequency in realizable two-layer ReLU teacher-student problems and the effect of one or two extra student neurons.
Training-error degradation with plain convolutional depth, prevention by identity shortcuts, and the specified tanh and Fixup exceptions.
Activation-matched initialization, signal and gradient propagation, orthogonal versus Gaussian initialization, training speed and trainable depth.
Learning rates relative to a measured stability threshold, transient loss growth, curvature reduction, edge-of-stability dynamics and divergence.
Batch normalization's effect on accuracy gain and learning-rate tolerance, and normalization-free Fixup comparisons.

record.verdict_notes: All reported states are changed to cannot_determine relative to V1–V6; this does not dispute the reported FID or probe differences. Here plain DiT still contains residual connections. Citations to Zhang et al., He et al. and Cohen et al. are background, not additional tests.

versions.untested_parts: Does not report CIFAR classification training error, random or corrupted classification labels, model-size fitting thresholds, or classification early stopping and regularization.
No two-layer teacher-student ReLU experiment, neuron-count sweep, or spurious-minimum frequency.
No plain versus identity-shortcut depth sweep for classification training error, and no relevant plain tanh depth experiment.
No initialization comparison of activation/gradient propagation or trainable depth for classification error.
No learning-rate sweep around a stability threshold, loss-curvature dynamics, or edge-of-stability measurement.
No batch-normalization comparison or training-speed/learning-rate-tolerance measurement.

rows.subject: plain DiT-B/16, pixel x-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Train plain DiT on ImageNet-1k pixel patches with x-prediction; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: Diffusion generation quality, not training classification error.
rows.check: Generation FID does not measure any claim version.

rows.subject: plain DiT-B/16, pixel v-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Train plain DiT on ImageNet-1k pixel patches with direct v-prediction; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: The paper describes plain v-prediction as failing catastrophically; this is a generation FID result, not classification error.
rows.check: Poor generation FID does not establish absence of any version's optimization effect.

rows.subject: plain DiT-B/16, whitened-space x-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Train the same direct JiT-B/16 backbone after invertible patch whitening; evaluate FID after mapping generated samples back.
rows.note: The paper calls this a degradation of x-prediction success. FID does not measure classification training error.
rows.check: Whitening changes data coordinates; its generation FID does not test any version.

rows.subject: plain DiT-B/16, whitened-space v-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Train the same direct backbone with v-prediction in whitened patch space; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: Generation quality worsens in whitened space; not classification training error.
rows.check: Whitened-space generation FID does not measure any claim version.

rows.subject: plain DiT-B/16, pixel v-prediction with four-stream mHC
rows.operation_detail: Expand persistent residual state with dynamic four-stream mHC while keeping computation widths fixed; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: Authors say mHC rescues v-prediction from complete failure; FID remains above x-prediction and does not measure classification training error.
rows.check: Expanded-state generation performance does not measure teacher-student spurious minima or another named effect.

rows.subject: DINOv2-B latent DiT with four-stream mHC, x-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Train in DINOv2-B latent space with mHC; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: Latent-space generation result; not classification training error.
rows.check: Latent generation FID does not measure any claim version.

rows.subject: DINOv2-B latent DiT with four-stream mHC, v-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Train in DINOv2-B latent space with mHC; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: The authors say the intervention nearly closes the x/v gap in DINOv2-B space; not classification training error.
rows.check: Closing the generation FID gap does not measure any claim version.

rows.subject: plain DiT-B/16 with mHC spatial input
rows.operation_detail: Assign each stream its own 8 × 8 input and prediction region under v-prediction; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: This is one stage of the SiHC design progression; not classification training error.
rows.check: Architecture ablation measuring generation FID; outside all versions.

rows.subject: plain DiT-B/16 with identity carry and static scalar maps
rows.operation_detail: Add identity carry and static scalar maps to spatial-input streams under v-prediction; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: Ablation progression result; not classification training error.
rows.check: Identity carry and static maps change together; no plain-network depth degradation comparison is reported.

rows.subject: SiHC-B, feature-wise maps
rows.operation_detail: Use spatial input, identity carry, and channel-specific static feature-wise read/write maps under v-prediction; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: Ablation progression result; not classification training error.
rows.check: Architecture ablation measuring generation FID; outside all versions.

rows.subject: SiHC-B, 4 × 4 subpatches
rows.operation_detail: Increase to sixteen local states, each predicting a 4 × 4 region, under direct v-prediction; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: The paper says this brings FID within the range of decoupled B-size models; not classification training error.
rows.check: Changing local state organization and bandwidth does not test any specified optimization effect.

rows.subject: SiHC-B, 4 × 4 subpatches with in-context class tokens
rows.operation_detail: Add 32 in-context class tokens to the 4 × 4 SiHC model under v-prediction; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: This is a reported change with class tokens; not classification training error.
rows.check: Class-token generation ablation is outside all versions; the same result is repeated in R13.

rows.subject: SiHC-B
rows.operation_detail: Train direct v-prediction SiHC with 32 in-context class tokens and no REPA; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: Generation outcome; not classification training error.
rows.check: Generation FID is outside all versions; duplicates R12's model and outcome.

rows.subject: SiHC-L
rows.operation_detail: Scale SiHC to L under direct v-prediction without REPA; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: The paper reports improvement with scale; FID is not training classification error.
rows.check: Generation improves with joint depth and width scaling; this does not measure training classification error or isolate depth degradation.

rows.subject: SiHC-H
rows.operation_detail: Scale SiHC to H under direct v-prediction without REPA; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: The paper reports improvement with scale; FID is not training classification error.
rows.check: Generation improves with joint depth and width scaling; this does not measure training classification error or isolate depth degradation.

rows.subject: SiHC-H
rows.operation_detail: Continue training the SiHC-H run beyond 200 epochs; evaluate generation FID.
rows.note: The paper reports the continued-training trajectory as leveling off around FID 2.06; this is not classification training error.
rows.check: A generation FID plateau does not establish incomplete fitting or any other version's effect.

rows.subject: SiHC-XL + REPA
rows.operation_detail: Train direct v-prediction SiHC with REPA; evaluate pixel-space generation FID.
rows.note: ImageNet generation result, not classification training error.
rows.check: The proposed method's generation performance does not test any version.

rows.subject: DeCo-B
rows.operation_detail: Train decoupled v-prediction model; report generation FID trajectory.
rows.note: The text reports all three decoupled models improve throughout training; selected terminal value shown.
rows.check: Generation FID over training epochs does not measure any version's training error or dynamics.

rows.subject: DiP-B
rows.operation_detail: Train decoupled v-prediction model; report generation FID trajectory.
rows.note: The text reports all three decoupled models improve throughout training; selected terminal value shown.
rows.check: Generation FID over training epochs does not measure any version's training error or dynamics.

rows.subject: PixelDiT-B
rows.operation_detail: Train decoupled v-prediction model; report generation FID trajectory.
rows.note: The text reports all three decoupled models improve throughout training; selected terminal value shown.
rows.check: Generation FID over training epochs does not measure any version's training error or dynamics.

rows.subject: JiT-B/16 with learned scalar input skip
rows.operation_detail: Train v-prediction with a learned direct noisy-input path and two scalar coefficients; report generation FID.
rows.note: The paper reports substantial FID improvement; the learned-skip generation result is not evidence about classification error.
rows.check: A learned input-to-output skip improves generation; there is no depth degradation or initialization comparison.

rows.subject: Swiss-roll toy flow-matching FCN, x-prediction
rows.size_stated: five residual ReLU blocks, width 256; ambient dimension 512
rows.operation_detail: Train toy flow-matching model on Swiss-roll data under x-prediction and measure residual-state variance rank.
rows.measure: Number of directions explaining 90% of hidden-state variance
rows.baseline: v-prediction requires over a hundred directions by the last block
rows.value: hidden states concentrate in a few directions except at the highest noise level
rows.note: Toy flow-matching residual-state diagnostic, not classification training error.
rows.check: Hidden-state variance rank is outside all versions. Measurements are inputs to blocks 1–5, rather than outputs after those blocks.

rows.subject: Swiss-roll toy flow-matching FCN, v-prediction
rows.size_stated: five residual ReLU blocks, width 256; ambient dimension 512
rows.operation_detail: Train toy flow-matching model on Swiss-roll data under v-prediction and measure residual-state variance rank.
rows.measure: Number of directions explaining 90% of hidden-state variance
rows.baseline: x-prediction concentrates hidden-state variance in a few directions
rows.value: over a hundred directions needed by the last block
rows.note: The paper also states that generation under v-prediction fails in this toy setting. This is not classification training error.
rows.check: Hidden-state variance rank is outside all versions. The final observation is the input to block 5, rather than its output.

rows.subject: plain DiT-B/16, pixel x-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Fit linear probes at residual-stream boundaries for ImageNet class labels.
rows.baseline: pixel v-prediction at 50% noise: final boundary 4.56%
rows.uncertainty: standard deviation across three noise draws; numeric SD not stated
rows.note: Class readability diagnostic, not training classification error.
rows.check: Frozen-feature probe validation accuracy is not backbone training classification error.

rows.subject: plain DiT-B/16, pixel v-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Fit linear probes at residual-stream boundaries for ImageNet class labels.
rows.uncertainty: standard deviation across three noise draws; numeric SD not stated
rows.note: Class readability diagnostic, not training classification error.
rows.check: Low probe validation accuracy does not establish absence of any version's optimization effect.

rows.subject: Pixel SiHC, v-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Fit linear probes at residual-stream workspace boundaries for ImageNet class labels.
rows.uncertainty: standard deviation across three noise draws; numeric SD not stated
rows.note: The paper describes class readability as recovered; this probe is not training classification error.
rows.check: Recovered probe validation accuracy measures class readability, outside all versions.

rows.subject: DINOv2-B latent DiT, x-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Fit linear probes at final measured residual boundary for ImageNet class labels.
rows.uncertainty: standard deviation across three noise draws; numeric SD not stated
rows.note: Separate noise-level results preserved in value; not classification training error.
rows.check: Frozen-feature probe validation accuracy does not measure any claim version.

rows.subject: DINOv2-B latent DiT, v-prediction
rows.operation_detail: Fit linear probes at final measured residual boundary for ImageNet class labels.
rows.baseline: DINOv2-B latent x-prediction at corresponding noise levels
rows.uncertainty: standard deviation across three noise draws; numeric SD not stated
rows.note: Separate noise-level results preserved in value; not classification training error.
rows.check: Frozen-feature probe validation accuracy does not measure any claim version.

rows.subject: DINOv2-B input control
rows.operation_detail: Fit a linear classifier directly to noisy encoder latents before the denoiser.
rows.uncertainty: SD across noise draws as reported
rows.note: Input representation control, not model training classification error.
rows.check: This is a linear classifier on frozen encoder inputs, not diffusion-backbone training error; outside all versions.
